name: H & K Fabrication - Pipe Welding and Fabrication Tools
old_description: We’re the ultimate destination for professional pipe welders seeking precision, durability, and performance in their pipe welding tools. Our carefully curated selection of pipe welding equipment is engineered to help pipe welders do their job easier and more efficiently.
about:
H & K Fabrication operates from Conway, Arkansas, supplying pipe welding tools and custom metal fabrication services to professional welders and industrial clients. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it presents itself as a specialist in pipe fabrication equipment and project-based fabrication work.

The business runs an e-commerce platform selling its own branded line of pipe welding tools, including Roll Out Wheels, Pipe Fitting Squares, Roller Heads, and Lathe Chucks, all featuring a zinc-plated finish. Alongside tool sales, the shop accepts custom fabrication projects ranging from custom bus racks to sanitizer stands, advertising that no project is too large or small. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Primary customers are professional pipe welders and pipefitters who purchase tools directly through the online store, as well as local businesses and contractors needing one-off fabricated assemblies. The company cites examples such as custom bus racks and sanitizer stands for area businesses, indicating a base in commercial and light industrial fabrication.

H & K Fabrication emphasizes that its tools are engineered to make pipe welding easier and more efficient, backed by a 30-day replacement guarantee for damaged or defective items. Standard shipping on tools runs three to five business days with an expedited option, and the company positions its curated product selection and project flexibility as its core differentiators.
